speaker: Doctor
text: Does the rash itch significantly, and do you notice any similar red, scaly patches in the folds of his neck, armpits, or diaper area?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the greasy yellow scales and the patient's age, this presentation is highly characteristic of infantile seborrheic dermatitis. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Scraping_KOH

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative KOH preparation rules out a fungal infection like tinea capitis. Since the clinical presentation of greasy yellow scales in a 3-month-old is classic for seborrheic dermatitis, and no other symptoms suggest an alternative diagnosis, I am confident in my assessment. DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile seborrheic dermatitis
